title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 11: Nahash threatens Jabesh Gilead, Saul rescues the city, and the kingdom is renewed at Gilgal.

questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 11:1 says Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead.

questions.text: On what condition would Nahash make a covenant with the men of Jabesh?
questions.explanation: Nahash said he would make it on the condition that all their right eyes be gouged out.

answers.text: That all their right eyes be gouged out
That they give him all their gold

questions.text: How many days did the elders of Jabesh ask for?
questions.explanation: The elders said, "Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel."

questions.text: What was Saul doing when he came and found the people weeping?
questions.explanation: Saul came following the oxen out of the field and asked why the people wept.

answers.text: Sitting at the gate of his house
Following the oxen out of the field
Offering a sacrifice at the altar

questions.text: What did Saul do with a yoke of oxen?
questions.explanation: He cut them in pieces and sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by messengers.

answers.text: Cut them in pieces and sent them out
Offered them as a burnt offering
Gave them to the men of Jabesh
Used them to plow his father's field

questions.text: Where did Saul count the people?
What message was sent to the men of Jabesh Gilead?
questions.explanation: "Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued."

answers.text: They should surrender to Nahash and live in peace
They would be rescued tomorrow when the sun was hot
They should flee to the hills by night and hide
They must wait seven more days for any help

questions.text: Into how many companies did Saul put the people?
questions.explanation: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies.

questions.text: What did Saul say when the people wanted to put to death those who had said, "Shall Saul reign over us?"
questions.explanation: Saul said, "No man shall be put to death today; for today Yahweh has rescued Israel."

answers.text: Bring them to me at once
No man shall be put to death today
Put them out of the camp

questions.text: Where did the people make Saul king before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: All the people went to Gilgal and made Saul king before Yahweh in Gilgal.
